## About
Bartell's started during the Great Depression, when a young Leslie B. Bartell sold eggs from his Dad's farm and bought a delivery truck. The Rahway teenager hauled fertilizer, coal and feed all over Union County, then rented a warehouse off Central Avenue and opened a feed store. As his son Leslie put it, "He would haul anything, anywhere, anytime."
These days it's more grass seed and garden hoses than manure and chicken feed. But Bartell's is still a small town operation, where a neighbor can walk in with a blighted tomato plant and walk out with suggestions for a cure.
We carry a complete line of products and tools for landscapers and homeowners. There's a retail store on Central Avenue in Clark and a bulk yard on Lake Avenue in Scotch Plains. Customers rate us 4.5 on Google from 184 reviews.

## Services
- Lawn & Garden Plant Diagnostics: Bring in a sample and we'll identify the insect, disease or weed, then offer a solution. It's free.
- Delivery Services: Our small fleet of 8 trucks delivers to homes and job sites. Delivery charges vary by location.
- Bulk garden supplies: Mulches, top soils, stone and sod, delivered to your home or job site.
- Techo Bloc pavers and walls: A full range of landscape and hardscape products, including Techo Bloc pavers and walls. Come see our displays.
- Firewood: Cut, split and ready to burn, for pickup or delivery. Pieces are sold at our Central Ave location too.
- Mushroom and lobster compost: One reviewer says we're the only ones in the area that have both.
- Ice melter, salt and snow shovels: Winter supplies, plus drainage products and PVC pipe.

## FAQ
Q: Do you have more than one location?
A: Yes. Our retail store is on Central Avenue in Clark, and our bulk location is on Lake Avenue in Scotch Plains.

Q: Do you deliver?
A: Yes, to your home or job site. Delivery charges vary by town.

Q: How do I get a sick plant looked at?
A: Bring in a plant sample that shows clear symptoms, sealed in a clear plastic bag. We'll diagnose it and suggest a fix.

Q: Can I buy less than a cord of firewood?
A: Yes. We sell pieces at our Central Ave location if you don't need a full or half cord.

Q: What towns do you serve?
A: Scotch Plains, Westfield, Cranford, Rahway, Mountainside, Colonia, Linden, Roselle, Watchung, Plainfield, Clark, Garwood, Roselle Park, Edison, Woodbridge and nearby areas.
